posts.name: Pranav Kapoor
posts.cooked:
I have submitted the BPT on the VM, and the key was initially created and submitted on the portal. Do we need to submit the same key again on the portal, or is it already considered submitted?

I need some clarification on this. Is there a short tutorial or guide we can follow? The instructions are a bit unclear. It would be helpful if someone could guide me on the next steps.

Thank you for your help.

posts.name: Tushar Thakur
posts.cooked: You can use the same public key for the oppe vm

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked:
pranav1.8:

Do we need to submit the same key again on the portal, or is it already considered submitted?

It doesn’t matter, you can use your old key or generate a new one. Think of your two VMs as online accounts and your keys as passwords to them. Just because both your online accounts belong to the same course, they need not have the same login password yes?
